fields.what: Bosonic motional mode of trapped ions (phonons) — layer 1, alternate on ion_chain, status E, since 1995

items.note: the editor's question 1: one L1 station for the ion motional mode as a bosonic carrier, status E, the g_bos widening in its brief (the brief's Role section: spin-dependent-force conditional displacements, the spin-dependent beam splitter, eSWAP; g_bos itself not edited). since 1995 by the map's rule — Monroe et al. 1995, the motional mode one of the two qubits of the controlled-NOT, the experiment that also dates `ion`; the engineering stage is Tsinghua 2023 (four modes, five ions), Sydney 2025 (two GKP qubits in two modes) and Maryland/Duke 2026 (Yukawa register). Intake rows: (a) Nature Physics 2026 — the occupations to eight phonons are fits over many shots in one mode of a two-mode run, not a single-shot Fock-resolved readout; (b) arXiv:2610.23208 an experiment (NUS, overlaps 63 ± 4% / 78 ± 3%, not gate fidelities); (c) arXiv:2610.13843 a proposal, graded [S]. Two conflict edges with their sources: g_ms (the shared modes; mitigated by partitioning the transverse mode families) and ro_fluor (bright-detection recoil destroys the register; open) (writer job 20261122-1)

fields.what: Zeeman ground-state qubit (nuclear-spin-free ion) — layer 2, alternate on ion_chain and ion_qccd, status D, since 2005

items.note: the editor's question 5: an L2 station for the Zeeman ground-state qubit of a nuclear-spin-free isotope. Status D — peer-reviewed multi-qubit hardware from Innsbruck (2005, 2026), Oxford (2006, 2015) and Mainz (2022) and AQT's 31-qubit LYNX register (company preprint, arXiv:2610.32518, §II: «The qubits are encoded in the two Zeeman states of the 4²S1/2 ground state»). since 2005: the Innsbruck pair stored and measured in the Zeeman sublevels (Häffner et al., Appl. Phys. B 81, 151); the first native gate found is 2006 (Oxford). LYNX's 2.84(8)×10⁻³ is the mean over the 276 pairs of its 24-qubit register; the 31-qubit register gives 1.0(1)×10⁻² over 10 pairs (writer job 20261122-1)

fields.what: Decoherence-protected electron–nuclear gate (DD / DDRF; colour centres) — layer 3, alternate on defect, status D, since 2012

items.note: the editor's question 4: an L3 station for the two-qubit gate of colour-centre registers — the electron's decoupling pulses timed to a nuclear spin's hyperfine precession (DD) or interleaved with phase-tracked RF pulses (DDRF). Status D (TU Delft/QuTech since 2012, Chicago on SiC 2020, Harvard/AWS on SiV 2022); since 2012 (van der Sar et al., Nature 484, 82). The «< 0.1%» GST figure the Atlas carries in g_mwspin and defect from the Fujitsu/QuTech trade press is Bartling et al., Phys. Rev. Applied 23, 034052 (2025, arXiv:2403.10633): its two-qubit 99.93(5)% is this gate. The intake paper (arXiv:2610.26413) drives the gate from a cryo-CMOS controller at 6 K: Bell 88.6(8)%, gate ≥ 95(2)% (a lower bound) (writer job 20261122-1)

fields.what: Optical delivery of qubit control (fibre link + cryogenic photodiode) — layer 5, alternate on sc, status E, since 2024

items.note: the editor's question 7: an L5 station for optical delivery of control to superconducting qubits, status E; the name says «qubit control» because the USTC link carries the flux pulses too. since 2024 under the benchmarked-gate reading applied to ct_fdm on 7 Nov 2026 (the earliest benchmarked gate found: USTC, Optics Express 32, 3989, Jan 2024, single-qubit XEB error 0.139%); NIST's 2021 drive (Lecocq et al., Nature 591, 575) benchmarked no gate. The «> 99.9%» of the intake is the XEB Pauli fidelity 99.915 ± 0.005% of PRA 114, 032427 (arXiv:2608.19602, photodiodes at 4 K); the 10-km link (arXiv:2611.12481) is a preprint: RB (95.36 ± 0.13)%, Bell 80.6 ± 13.1%. Conflict edge with transmon (shot noise and dissipated light; mitigated by the 4 K placement) (writer job 20261122-1)

fields.what: Tensor-network maximum-likelihood decoders (offline) — layer 8, alternate on sc, status E, since 2023

items.note: the editor's question 6: an L8 station for tensor-network maximum-likelihood decoders, status E, offline — said in the name, the one_line, the verdict and the Role and Control sections. since 2023: Google Quantum AI's Sycamore memory decoded by MPS contraction at χ = 30 (Nature 614, 676), the earliest tensor-network decode of hardware data found. The intake paper, unverified by the cloud's run, was read at its own text in its arXiv version (arXiv:2602.21293 = Nature Physics, online 22 Oct 2026): Zhejiang University's 125-qubit processor, two interlaced d = 7 codes of 49 qubits each, single-shot bitstrings decoded offline by a TN-ML decoder (0.014(1) / 0.025(3)); the TN-Bayesian and matching decoders ran on the transition data of distances 2, 4 and 6 (writer job 20261122-1)

fields.what: Superconductor-digital fabrication (multilayer niobium processes, SFQ/AQFP logic) — layer 10, alternate on sc and anneal, status D, since 2010

items.note: the editor's question 2: one L10 station for superconductor-digital fabrication; the name says «multilayer niobium processes» (imec's 300 mm route is NbTiN; no NbN process was researched). Status D and slots sc and anneal: D-Wave's own papers describe its annealer stack — qubits, on-chip SFQ flux DACs and QFP readout — as one multilayer niobium process (four Nb layers, 2010; six superconducting metal layers with a 250 A/cm² trilayer, 2014); for gate-model machines the SFQ dies that drove qubits came from three-layer research processes (Wisconsin 2019, NIST 2023) and SEEQC's foundry (its 1 kA/cm² niobium process, arXiv:2503.09879 Suppl. A). since 2010 (D-Wave, Supercond. Sci. Technol. 23, 065004). The intake paper unverified by the cloud's run (Supercond. Sci. Technol. 39, 105024, SIMIT-Nb08) was read at its abstract only — iopscience refused the fetch and no arXiv copy exists — and the brief takes from it only what the abstract states (writer job 20261122-1)

fields.what: Quasiparticle and radiation hardening of superconducting circuits (gap engineering, phonon traps, event detectors) — layer 10, alternate on sc, status D, since 2022

items.note: the editor's question 3: one station for quasiparticle and radiation hardening of superconducting circuits, placed on L10 (manufacturing): gap engineering, low-gap traps and bandages, back-side phonon downconversion, high-gap base layers, and the event detectors. Status D — gap-engineered junctions in Google's 12-qubit test array and 72-qubit processor (Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 240601; Nature 638, 920), back-side copper at Syracuse/UW–Madison (Nat. Commun. 13, 6425), the junction gap landscape at MIT (Nat. Commun. 16, 6428), gap-engineered qubit junctions in SEEQC's SFQ-controlled module (arXiv:2503.09879); the MKID detector half alone would read E (LLNL, Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 044052: one of six qubits measured, no decoder use). since 2022: the earliest multi-qubit hardening hardware found (Iaia et al.); single-device gap engineering dates from 2004/2012 (writer job 20261122-1)

since years the editor may move, each one edit: phonon 1995 (alternative 2020, the first gate between two motional modes found — Gan et al., PRL 124, 170502); enc_zeeman 2005 (alternative 2006, the first native gate found); ct_optical 2024 (2021 if an unbenchmarked drive counts — NIST, Nature 591, 575); fab_qphard 2022 (2024 if the class is gap engineering only); fab_scd 2010 (Castellano et al. 2007, SFQ control of a flux qubit, not reached — it could pull the year earlier)

register follow-ups the LYNX preprint fills (arXiv:2610.32518): T1 10(3) s, T2 0.35(10) s Ramsey and 3.3(5) s with a π pulse every 300 µs (the paper calls the echoed value T2*), two-qubit gate about 210 µs, measurement about 2 ms, SPAM 11(1)×10⁻⁴; the briefs/{en,ru,he}/enc_opt.md files still list LYNX under the optical qubit (records table, Who table, Role) — a text job

the «< 0.1%» GST figure in g_mwspin (records, brief) and defect (records) rests on trade press with «no primary paper»; the paper is Bartling et al., Phys. Rev. Applied 23, 034052 (2025, arXiv:2403.10633): its two-qubit 99.93(5)% is the DDRF gate of g_ddhf, its single-qubit 99.991(4)% (electron) and 99.999(1)% (¹⁴N) stay with g_mwspin; the g_mwspin texts that say «hyperfine-conditional gates» and «1Q spins» could name g_ddhf for the entangling gate — a text job in three languages

the colour-centre architecture holds no cryo-CMOS control: arXiv:2610.26413 drives an NV register's two-qubit gate from a cryo-CMOS controller at 6 K (one group, a preprint) — a candidate alternate for slot 5. g_ddhf entered slot 3 as an alternate beside g_mwspin; as the architecture's only entangling gate it could be primary, which would make its ~0.5 ms set the derived local clock — the editor's call

GKP in ion motion is older than enc_gkp's since 2020 (Flühmann et al., Nature 566, 513, Feb 2019) and has a two-qubit GKP gate (Matsos et al., Nat. Phys. 21, 1664, 2025): adding phonon to enc_gkp's carrier group would move its since to 2019 and needs enc_gkp in ion_chain slot 2 — the editor's call
the cx_bus brief says a fourth bosonic mode «had to run in a separate circuit»; the Maryland/Duke paper's reason is that the mode decouples in the model, not a hardware limit — a text job

the transmon record «correlated burst rate ~1 per hour on the 72-qubit processor … 10⁻¹⁰ logical floor» is the residual of a gap-engineered processor, bursts Google calls «different from previously observed high-energy impact events»; the conflict edges ct_sfq–transmon (gap engineering already among its mitigations; SEEQC 2026 drove gap-engineered qubits by SFQ with no T1 loss on one qubit) and ic_transducer–transmon (a Nb/Au-island transmon stood >10× more 1550 nm light, Chalmers preprint) could cite the new evidence; their status stays open

status choices the editor may move: ct_optical kept E as the editor decided, though peer-reviewed hardware exists from four groups; dec_tn kept E as the editor decided (two groups, both peer-reviewed); fab_scd D only with the annealer slot (gate-model use alone would read E); fab_qphard D for the station, its detector half alone E

the ct_sfq brief's 2014 records row gives D-Wave 4,544 flux DACs, citing the same work [430] whose §III.E gives 4,608 DACs for 512 qubits on 56 lines (read for fab_scd and re-checked at the source by its checker) — a text check for ct_sfq in three languages (writer job 20261122-1)
